Self-deportation.question: The _____ was US and UK approach for illegal immigration.
Self-deportation.fact: Self-deportation is an anti-immigration political policy, used mainly in the United States and the United Kingdom, that promotes the voluntary departure of immigrants from their host country. Self-deportation became associated with illegal immigration to the United States in the 1990s and later prominently became an official policy of the second presidency of Donald Trump in 2025.
